# Impact Report

**Author:** Rajveer Sharma
**Date:** 19 Oct 2026 (generated by `python -m ott_agent report`; simulator seed `oua-practice`)

## Headline

Intention-to-treat over all 1,746 viewers with a replay trigger (863 agent arm, 883 holdout; randomized by `replay/arms.csv`). The agent published something for 719 agent-arm viewers; everyone is counted, served or not.

- **Goal success:** 13.5% vs 11.4%, difference +2.1 pt (95% CI [-1.2 pt, +5.4 pt]; bootstrap [-1.2 pt, +5.4 pt]).
- **Any play within 7 days:** 67.4% vs 64.9%, difference +2.5 pt (95% CI [-1.9 pt, +7.0 pt]).
- Minimum detectable effect at 80% power: about 4.8 pt for goal success, 6.3 pt for play within 7 days.

An interval that includes 0 means this run cannot tell the agent's effect apart from no effect. That is reported as is; it is not rounded up into a claim.

## Agent arm vs holdout (intention-to-treat)

| Metric | Agent arm | Holdout arm | Difference | 95% CI | Excludes 0? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Intended-goal success (primary) | 13.5% (102/758) | 11.4% (85/748) | **+2.1 pt** | [-1.2 pt, +5.4 pt] | no |
| Any play within 7 days (primary) | 67.4% (582/863) | 64.9% (573/883) | **+2.5 pt** | [-1.9 pt, +7.0 pt] | no |
| Finished an episode within 3 days | 35.6% (307/863) | 29.3% (259/883) | **+6.2 pt** | [+1.8 pt, +10.6 pt] | yes |
| Paid purchase within 7 days (not paying at start) | 4.5% (24/537) | 6.0% (32/536) | **-1.5 pt** | [-4.2 pt, +1.2 pt] | no |
| Came back on a later IST day within 7 days | 81.3% (702/863) | 80.2% (708/883) | **+1.2 pt** | [-2.5 pt, +4.9 pt] | no |

The first two rows are the pre-declared primary metrics. The rest are secondary: with several metrics, one interval excluding 0 can happen by chance, so a secondary result is a lead to re-test, not a finding.

Goal success counts only decided goals: inconclusive verdicts (deadline past the end of the outcome data, invalidated goals) are excluded from both arms alike. Verdict counts: agent: 656 failed, 102 succeeded; holdout: 663 failed, 85 succeeded.

## Was doing nothing the right call?

Viewers whose first trigger already ruled out acting, compared across arms (play within 7 days). Similar rates mean the agent's abstention cost nothing measurable.

| Metric | Agent arm | Holdout arm | Difference | 95% CI | Excludes 0? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| first trigger stale (offline-buffered) | 41.3% (43/104) | 50.0% (67/134) | **-8.7 pt** | [-20.9 pt, +4.1 pt] | no |
| app dialect has no content (d7/NA/unknown) | 7.8% (5/64) | 14.0% (7/50) | **-6.2 pt** | [-19.2 pt, +5.4 pt] | no |

## Why "served vs everyone else" misleads

These comparisons are biased and are shown only to make the point (play within 7 days):

| Comparison (biased) | Served viewers | Comparison group | Difference | 95% CI | Excludes 0? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Served (agent arm) vs everyone else | 74.8% (538/719) | 60.1% (617/1027) | **+14.7 pt** | [+10.3 pt, +19.0 pt] | yes |
| Served vs unserved, agent arm only | 74.8% (538/719) | 30.6% (44/144) | **+44.3 pt** | [+35.7 pt, +51.8 pt] | yes |

The agent serves a selected group: viewers in a live session, in a dialect with content, with an eligible goal and no live page. Those traits predict watching on their own. Comparing them with everyone else measures the selection, not the agent. Only the randomized comparison above isolates the agent's effect.

If all of the effect runs through serving, the effect per served viewer (CACE) is about +3.1 pt on play within 7 days (ITT ÷ served share 83%). This inherits the ITT uncertainty.

## Pilot re-analysis

| Comparison | Group A | Group B | Difference | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Internal report: served vs everyone else | 40.1% (n=217) | 17.7% (n=3,674) | +22.4 pt | [+16.0 pt, +29.2 pt] |
| Within treatment: served vs unserved | 40.1% (n=217) | 15.5% (n=1,695) | +24.6 pt | [+18.1 pt, +31.5 pt] |
| **Randomized arms (ITT)** | 18.3% (n=1,912) | 19.6% (n=1,979) | -1.3 pt | [-3.8 pt, +1.2 pt] |

The pilot report's +22.4 pt "uplift" compares the 11% of treatment users the agent chose to serve with everyone else (unserved treatment users plus the holdout). The randomized comparison shows no detectable effect. The pilot did not show that the agent helped.
